scripts.build: bun run build:hub && bun run build:web
scripts.build:exe: bun run build:web && (cd packages/hub && bun run generate:embedded-web-assets) && (cd packages/cli && bun run build:exe)
scripts.build:exe:all: bun run build:web && (cd packages/hub && bun run generate:embedded-web-assets) && (cd packages/cli && bun run build:exe --all)
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:shared && bun run typecheck:node-core && bun run typecheck:daemon && bun run typecheck:session && bun run typecheck:hub && bun run typecheck:cli && bun run typecheck:web
scripts.test: bun run test:shared && bun run test:node-core && bun run test:daemon && bun run test:session && bun run test:hub && bun run test:cli && bun run test:web
scripts.lint: eslint packages/shared/src packages/node-core/src packages/daemon/src packages/session/src packages/hub/src packages/cli/src packages/web/src
scripts.lint:deps: depcruise packages/shared/src packages/node-core/src packages/daemon/src packages/session/src packages/hub/src packages/cli/src packages/web/src
